## My Interactive Data Visualizations

Gallery of my animint visualizations created using R.
```{r gallery_table}
meta <- if(file.exists("meta.csv")) {
  read.csv("meta.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
} else {
  data.frame(repo = character(), title = character(), 
             source = character(), viz.link = character(), 
             screenshot = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

if(nrow(meta) > 0) {
  for(i in 1:nrow(meta)) {
    row <- meta[i,]
    
    # Screenshot
    if(!is.na(row$screenshot) && row$screenshot != "") {
      cat(sprintf('<a href="%s"><img src="%s" width="400"/></a>\n\n', 
                  row$viz.link, row$screenshot))
    }
    
    # Title
    cat(sprintf('### %s\n\n', row$title))
    
    # Links
    cat(sprintf('[View Viz](%s) | [GitHub](%s) | [Source](%s)\n\n---\n\n',
                row$viz.link,
                paste0('https://github.com/', row$repo),
                row$source))
  }
} else {
  cat("Run animint2::update_gallery() to populate gallery.")
}
```
